authors: Amit Chanda, Abdulrahman Alfadhli, Vijay Sethuraman and Siva Nadimpalli
abstract: Maximum stress experienced by an electrode during cycling is shown to cause mechanical degradation and capacity fade, but the effect of potential window and stress range (Δσ) on cycling behavior was not investigated. Here, stresses generated in hard carbon (HC)-based porous composite electrodes were measured in situ while cycling under three different potential windows: (i) full window (2–0.0005 V vs Na/Na+), (ii) sloping (2–0.1 V vs Na/Na+), and plateau (0.1–0.0005 V vs Na/Na+) regions and three different C-rates.
